title: improv·artist · explosive (Cai Guo-Qiang)
mutation_directive: improv artist: explosive via Cai Guo-Qiang

improv_extras.practice: gunpowder drawings, fireworks, flash and char; ephemeral pyrotechnics

v1.feedback: The vascular-sphere vessel is a strong recognizable form and the earth-tone palette (amber→sienna→ash) is exactly right; the multi-phase pulse→freeze→burst narrative genuinely channels Cai Guo-Qiang's controlled pyrotechnics. Post-detonation, the leaf-embers risk dissolving into a dispersing point cloud with no readable silhouette — consider letting fragments trace visible gunpowder-arc curves (bezier trails or fade-streaks) so the burst retains compositional structure rather than expanding into empty space. The flash light intensity spike should be brief and modest to avoid washing out the char-mark trail detail that sells the rice-paper metaphor.

v2.feedback: The vascular-sphere-to-gunpowder-drawing narrative arc is well-conceived and the differential-growth phase delivers recognizable biomorphic form with a restrained char/amber/bone palette. Two refinements: the bezier trails radiating outward from a central sphere risk reading as a thread-burst variant — break the radial symmetry harder by clustering detonation origins on one hemisphere or staggering arc timing so the burst reads as directional shockwave rather than omnidirectional bloom. Second, the flash phase should be verified to stay subtle (the 0xff9040 point light at intensity 3.5 may blow out the amber palette during peak — consider clamping the flash multiplier and using tone-mapping to keep the hottest moment feeling like smoldering char, not stage pyrotechnics).
